Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

RECODE-H: A Benchmark for Research Code Development with Interactive Human Feedback (2510.06186v2) · paper method: The seven-model study fixes generation temperature 0 and top-p 1, allows at most ten feedback rounds and three agent actions per turn, and reports richer-feedback gains in correctness and task-solve metrics; the highest level includes answer-code snippets, so gains are conditional on that extra information.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

RECODE-H: A Benchmark for Research Code Development with Interactive Human Feedback (2510.06186v2) · paper method: RECODE-H construction uses 26 PhD-level researchers with relevant top-conference publications to review Gemini-2.5-Pro drafts of code comments, instructions and tests; included open-source research implementations must execute successfully and require less than 24 GB GPU memory.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

RECODE-H: A Benchmark for Research Code Development with Interactive Human Feedback (2510.06186v2) · paper method: MRR is defined by the first turn producing test-correct code and Recall@n by tasks solved within n turns; CodeBLEU and CodeBERTScore compare against canonical implementations. The conclusion leaves actual human-in-the-loop feedback and broader research stages for future work.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

RECODE-H: A Benchmark for Research Code Development with Interactive Human Feedback (2510.06186v2) · paper method: The five feedback levels range from execution logs through diagnosis and repair guidance to explicitly supplying the correct code snippet. GPT-o4-mini simulates an expert using execution results, canonical code and annotated comments; the evaluation feedback is model-generated rather than a live human trial.
